title: ambrosia dumosa
intro: Ambrosia dumosa, commonly known as gumweed, is a perennial plant that belongs to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It has been used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of colds, coughs, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Ambrosia dumosa include its ability to stimulate the respiratory system, making it useful in treating respiratory issues like bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
